title: Porometer
content: Porometer is a Belgium-based supplier of pore size distribution and capillary flow porometry instruments for membranes, nonwovens, hollow fibers, engineered materials, and other porous media. Its portfolio includes the POROLUX and POROLIQ product lines, related software, wetting liquids, and contract testing support. These capabilities are relevant to aerogel R&D and characterization workflows where pore structure, permeability, and repeatable porous-material measurement matter. Porometer fits the Equipment Materials category as a specialized laboratory instrumentation supplier for teams working on aerogel testing, porous-media analysis, and material qualification.
